name: myinstants-macos
description: Unofficial native macOS client for myinstants.com: browse, play, favorite, upload and delete instant sound buttons.

scripts.ffmpeg: mkdir -p bin && cp node_modules/ffmpeg-static/ffmpeg node_modules/ffmpeg-static/ffmpeg.LICENSE bin/
scripts.postbuild: find MyInstants-darwin-arm64/MyInstants.app -name '._*' -delete && for h in "MyInstants Helper.app" "MyInstants Helper (GPU).app" "MyInstants Helper (Renderer).app" "MyInstants Helper (Plugin).app"; do codesign --force --sign - "MyInstants-darwin-arm64/MyInstants.app/Contents/Frameworks/$h"; done && codesign --force --deep --sign - MyInstants-darwin-arm64/MyInstants.app && codesign --verify --deep --strict MyInstants-darwin-arm64/MyInstants.app
